confidence_notes: Based on 6 web searches (1 RBA, 5 price checks), read through search-result summaries only. No pages were opened directly, and the RBA rate also comes from such a summary of RBA pages. Meals and coffee are best supported by Numbeo-type aggregates: inexpensive meal about NT$150-175, mid-range dinner for two about NT$1,000, cappuccino about NT$93. Beer is uncertain: Numbeo shows about NT$48-50 per pint, likely skewed by specials, versus NT$89-119 at convenience-store bars, so about NT$90 was used. Cocktail (dated guides NT$120-200) and wine (only Taipei NT$300-500 per glass found) were set at roughly 2.3x and 2.5x the beer price. NT$ were converted at an assumed 31.5 TWD per USD from general knowledge, not searched. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kaohsiung-specific aggregates were used for food and coffee. Drinks and accommodation were scaled from Taiwan and Taipei norms, discounted for a southern port city. Expatistan summaries show Kaohsiung roughly 15% cheaper than Taipei and about 18% above Tainan.
